lessons.title: Missing values
lessons.content: Measure missingness before acting. Fill values only when a defensible rule exists; otherwise retain or remove rows deliberately.

lessons.title: Duplicates
lessons.content: Define which columns identify a record, inspect duplicates, then remove or reconcile them with an auditable rule.

lessons.title: Transformation
lessons.content: Standardize types and categories, create derived columns, and validate ranges after each transformation.
